observations: PYRO1_OUT (R173.1) to BUZZ_G track (17.75,58.87) is 0.510 mm on B.Cu (recorded in D-R18-05 / D-R26-02) and is not a row of R10_VALIDATION §1's pair table; with the bus enabled a bridge passes at most about 8.4 V / ~0.9 kOhm (R162 1k to PC14 || R163 10k), about 9 mA, far below the 0.30 A no-fire, so it cannot fire; the table does not claim completeness.

U9 IN (BAT_IN track (18.25,83.56)) to RAW_PROTECTED (18.75,81.6) is 0.200 mm under U9 (TI RPW land); a bridge bypasses U9 and turns the board on with J400 open. Owner row 2 does not name it explicitly, but no requirement claims single-fault immunity, and per-flight step 2 (board off with J400 open) detects it before the e-match goes in.

BAT_ENABLE to BAT_OVLO (U9.1-U9.2, 0.200 mm): with J400 open a bridge gives EN about 8.4 x (280k||300k)/(2M + 280k||300k) = 0.57 V < 1.183 V, so it cannot turn the board on; closed, it pulls OVLO up and holds U9 off (fail-safe).
ACT_GATE to BAT_IN 0.2177 mm (B.Cu, track (14.475,72.2) to Q120.9) and 0.422 mm (F.Cu): a bridge holds Q120/Q121 off (fail-safe; the powered-BUS refusal sees a dead bus).

Rule 3's reversed-polarity meter note ('open or slowly rising'): a finite path exists through the IO2 VDD clamp, 3V3, D120 and the ~21 kOhm cold-pull-up/CONT chain to GND and back through 0.91 kOhm, so a meter may settle at tens of kOhm plus two diode drops; this still meets the stated pass criterion (above 0.9 kOhm or open), and the meter reading is labelled Inference.

M3_R10 Firmware option paragraph: 'R121 x C120 = 10 ms time constant' is arithmetically true; the Thevenin constant is (R121 || 50 kOhm) x C120 = 8.3 ms nominal and parts_budget tau_max is 10.75 ms; 'turn on within a few ms' holds (about 3.9 ms to -2.3 V at 7.4 V).

Leak thresholds in §1 mix corners: the RAW_ACT / ACT_EN / BAT_FAULT_N latch figures use the 1.116 V falling maximum only, while the U9.1-IN row is an envelope over 1.183-1.223 V and 7.4-8.4 V; each figure is a correct calculation for its stated basis.

Rule 4's 0.96 x VLOGIC-derived pack band against a Q120-off body-diode feed depends on the diode drop at the ~0.7 mA divider current and on the U9/U11 drop between BAT_IN and VLOGIC; the record says to qualify the band on first articles, and the dummy-load BAT_IN - RAW_ACT > 0.2 V criterion is the deterministic check.
